name: 16d z-loss three logits
title: z-loss on three logits
subtitle: Softmax over logits; cross entropy with the first token correct; z-loss = 0.0001 times (log Z) squared

steps.caption: Logits 2, 1 and 0 give probabilities 0.665, 0.245 and 0.090. The log of the softmax normalizer, log Z, is 2.408.
Adding 100 to every logit leaves the probabilities and the cross entropy of 0.408 unchanged, because the cross entropy gradient, -0.335, 0.245 and 0.090, sums to zero. Only log Z moves, to 102.408.
The z-loss 0.0001 x (log Z)^2 is 0.00058 for the original logits and 1.049 for the shifted ones, so it is the only term that tells the two apart.
Its gradient is 2 x 0.0001 x log Z x p, here 0.0136, 0.0050 and 0.0018. All three are positive, so a gradient step lowers every logit and pulls log Z back toward 0.
Drift costs precision. In bf16 the gap between neighbouring numbers is 0.0156 near 2, 0.5 near 102 and 4 near 1,000, so large logits can no longer hold small differences.
